summary: Refined the vetala ghost walk motion to feature grounded weight transfer, squared sine arc spacing for limbs, and organic torso posture and arm follow-through while keeping root motion untouched.
expectedEffect: Torso leans and shifts weight over supporting limbs with squared swing envelopes and phase-derived secondary responses.
